C0170.title: Self-Developed Game Cheat Earns 200,000 Yuan, Developer Sentenced to Three Years
C0170.summary: In the first half of 2024, Gai Moumou initially acted as an agent selling cheats for the game 'Dragon Oath' before learning programming on his own to develop a custom cheat named 'Wuming Cheat.' The tool employed memory injection techniques to automate in-game functions such as map clearing and resource collection.
